title: Error [AI_APICallError]: messages.12.content.1.image.source.base64.data: The image specified was not valid
body:
### Description

When using `experimental_attachments` some images with a `.jpg` extension give an error:

Error [AI_APICallError]: messages.12.content.1.image.source.base64.data: The image specified was not valid
    at <unknown> (node_modules/@ai-sdk/anthropic/node_modules/@ai-sdk/provider-utils/src/response-handler.ts:58:15)
    at async postToApi (node_modules/@ai-sdk/anthropic/node_modules/@ai-sdk/provider-utils/src/post-to-api.ts:81:27)
    at async AnthropicMessagesLanguageModel.doStream (node_modules/@ai-sdk/anthropic/src/anthropic-messages-language-model.ts:282:49)
    at async fn (node_modules/ai/core/generate-text/stream-text.ts:506:24)
    at async (node_modules/ai/core/telemetry/record-span.ts:18:21)
    at async _retryWithExponentialBackoff (node_modules/ai/util/retry-with-exponential-backoff.ts:37:11)
    at async streamStep (node_modules/ai/core/generate-text/stream-text.ts:461:14)
    at async fn (node_modules/ai/core/generate-text/stream-text.ts:965:8)
    at async (node_modules/ai/core/telemetry/record-span.ts:18:21)
  56 |       return {
  57 |         responseHeaders,
> 58 |         value: new APICallError({
     |               ^
  59 |           message: errorToMessage(parsedError),
  60 |           url,
  61 |           requestBodyValues, {
  cause: undefined,
  url: 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',
  requestBodyValues: [Object],
  statusCode: 400,
  responseHeaders: [Object],
  responseBody: '{"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"messages.12.content.1.image.source.base64.data: The image specified was not valid"}}',
  isRetryable: false,
  data: [Object]
}

### Code example

```json
{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "test",
    "experimental_attachments": [
        {
            "url": "https://7cvq9ppwadyagnal.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/WechatIMG159-yKOSwrshWCckNkCKauHpvQwazHqVMo.jpg",
            "name": "WechatIMG159.jpg",
            "contentType": "image/jpeg"
        }
    ]
}
```

### AI provider

@ai-sdk/anthropic 1.0.5

### Additional context

_No response_

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue involves an error when invoking an LLM provider (Anthropic) with image attachments, referencing SDK parameters and model API behavior. It matches the "Incompatibility with LLM providers" and "Tool invocation" criteria in the agent issue taxonomy.
